# hishan.me

> > A portfolio of full-stack software projects spanning robotics, mobile applications, healthcare systems, and IoT solutions.

Hishan Indrajith's project portfolio showcasing expertise in computer vision, Android development, backend systems, and IoT. Projects range from academic competitions to real-world applications built with Python, Java, and mobile technologies.

## Key Topics

- Computer Vision
- Python/OpenCV
- Android Development
- Firebase
- Java
- Robot Navigation
- Path Following
- Google Maps API
- IoT Systems
- Multithreaded Architecture
- MySQL
- Arduino
- GPS Tracking
- Healthcare Systems
- Stock Exchange Trading

## Computer Vision & Robotics

- [Python/OpenCV Path Following and Arrow Detection](https://hishan.me/opencv.html): Python/OpenCV implementation for robot navigation using line and arrow detection with directional analysis

## Mobile Applications

- [iservant](https://hishan.me/iservant.html): Android domestic services app with Firebase backend and Google Maps integration for service provider discovery
- [Dogapp](https://hishan.me/dogapp.html): Android GPS-based application for dog counting and location tracking to support population control initiatives

## Backend & Systems

- [Pera EMS](https://hishan.me/peraems.html): Computerized Electronic Medical System for University of Peradeniya health center management
- [Multithreaded Auction Server/Client System](https://hishan.me/auctionsystem.html): Java socket-based multithreaded auction system designed for stock exchange trading with concurrent client handling

## IoT & Hardware

- [Networked Weather Monitoring and Alerting System](https://hishan.me/weather.html): Arduino-based IoT system for automated weather monitoring with network connectivity and alert notifications
